sections.title: Vision Statement
paragraphs: A leading institution of excellence in delivering education and training in the Philippines and beyond.

sections.title: Mission Statement
paragraphs: Deeply committed to promoting knowledge, humaneness and leadership.

sections.title: Philosophy of the College
paragraphs: The motto of CRISTAL e-COLLEGE is Eruditio, gubernatio, et humanitas. It is translated as knowledge, leadership, and humanity. Knowledge is the anchor that brings about essential qualities of leadership. Enlightened leadership is a means toward achieving the true essence of humanity.

sections.title: Quality Objectives
paragraphs: CRISTAL e-COLLEGE is committed to the development and implementation of effective operation of its quality standards as expressed in these objectives.
items: Minimize employee’s turnover to 25% after two years.
Reduce customer complaints by 20% annually.
Increase local linkages to 50% and international linkages to 30% by 2024.
Subject 1 department to accreditation by a local certifying body in the next 3 years.
Design, implement, monitor and evaluate employees’ development program within 3 years.
Increase employees’ Satisfaction Index by 1% annually.
Increase customer Satisfaction Index by 1% annually.
Create a culture of risk based thinking.
Reduce non-conformances by 20% after one year.
sections.note: Targets and dates are reproduced from the supplied document.

sections.title: Quality Policy Statement
paragraphs: Imbued with high sense of responsibility, Cristal e-College is committed to provide quality educational opportunities to its students and professionals. The College aspires to continually improve delivery of services compliant to the needs of all interested parties.
The College is committed to provide conducive learning environment leading to knowledge, leadership, and humaneness to produce par excellent graduates who can lead local and global communities.
The College shall consistently review the policy and quality objectives regularly for continued relevance and sustainability; maintain and improve an efficient quality system.
sections.note: Will Tyron B. Tirol, Ph.D. — President (signatory in the supplied document).

sections.title: Institutional Goals
items: Caters educational opportunities for learners to initiate generation of knowledge.
Prepares par excellent graduates who can compassionately lead local and global communities.
Create a highly conducive environment for teaching and non-teaching staff to thrive personally and professionally.
Builds strong linkages, partnerships and collaborations with the local and global communities.
Updates the equipment and facilities in providing world class amenities for the academic community.
Translates a sturdy financial management or organizational sustainability.

rules: Reservation must be made at least two (2) days before the scheduled date of laboratory activity.
Requesting party must completely fill-out this form.
Signatory for the requesting party for a laboratory/student’s activity must be the instructor.

If the schedule of the laboratory session is more than (1) one day, the Laboratory In-charge with the Instructor will conduct an inventory of the tools and equipment every after start and end of the laboratory session.
In case the items or equipment is/are damaged or lost, the borrower(s) needs to replace the material with the same specification. Arrangement will be made with the Laboratory In-Charge.
